per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must be a 4-digit code
Name must follow Title Case convention (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female)
ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
ID_No must be unique across the dataset
ID_No must exactly match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must be either Male or Female
Age must be parseable as a numeric value
Age must be an integer without decimal places
Age must be between 13 and 120 inclusive
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9, optionally prefixed with +65 or 65)
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Email must be in lowercase
Country must be standardized to 'Singapore'
Street_Name must not be in all uppercase
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Name must be consistent with Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty (accounting for case, whitespace, and standardization of particles)
S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key)
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
